outcome.text:
# Issue #301: Land the reviewed #169 readiness case and record re-review #298 with one script run

## Goal
Review #297 accepted the #292 readiness-case proposal (property expectations only). Re-review #298 accepted the #212 diagram-difference gap row (item A). For item B (#281 split-checker fix), #298 reported masked revert results, but the Policymaker measured that reverting either fix makes `split_boundary.py --check` exit 1. Expected gain: main gets benchmark/native/readiness-case.json pinned under the oracle milestone, and the two stale "not re-reviewed" limitation sentences are replaced with exact records. The next Policymaker checks: evaluator --check exit 0, missing [], 60 refs, and readiness-case.json in the oracle pins.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Turn 1: write `.session/report.md` (status wip).
- [ ] Run once from main: `python3 -I -B execution/scripts/pin_readiness_300.py`. It is hash-gated and idempotent. Do not edit its outputs by hand.
- [ ] If the script exits non-zero, report its exact stderr and stop; do not work around it.
- [ ] Run the Verification command and report its output. Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits. No `__pycache__`.
## Verification
`python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`
## Context
- Script: execution/scripts/pin_readiness_300.py (written by Policymaker #300, dry-run twice on a copy of main).
- Reviews: .github/loop/data/session-reports/297/ and 298/ snapshots.
## Budget
- At most 8 tool calls. Do not open case JSON, results JSON, sources.json or lineage.json.
